svg.text: Neo4j Knowledge Graph Schema — Entities, Properties & Relationships
Updated 2026-11-19 — 8 Node Labels (Department, JobPosition, TargetRole, Level, Competency, MicroSkill, LearningModule, Certificate) & 9 Directed Relationship Types
• Department owns JobPositions via HAS_JOB_POSITION; composite unique constraint on (organizationId, code).
• RIASEC: all six integer scores 0–40 or all absent on JobPosition; missing is not zero; six zeros are valid.
• Employee RIASEC drafts, answers, personal scores & AI recommendations are stored in PostgreSQL V74.
• TargetRole status lifecycle: DRAFT, STAGED, SENT, SUBMITTED, REJECTED,
• isStaffingEnabled is true for STAGED/SENT/SUBMITTED staffing roles and
automatically cleared to false when PUBLISHED, ACTIVE, or REJECTED.
• Role levels live strictly as :Level nodes via :HAS_LEVEL (never on TargetRole.levels).
• Neo4j owns catalog definitions only; learner selections, assessment attempts,
official evidence, certificate submissions & pathways live in PostgreSQL.
• HAS_JOB_POSITION (Department → JobPosition): id, organizationId, status, version, createdAt, updatedAt (String)
• HAS_ROLE (JobPosition → TargetRole): id, organizationId, version, status, reviewStatus, updatedAt (DateTime | String)
• HAS_LEVEL (TargetRole → Level): id, organizationId, version, status, reviewStatus, createdAt, updatedAt (DateTime | String)
• HAS_COMPETENCY (Level → Competency) & HAS_SKILL (Competency → MicroSkill): id, version, status, reviewStatus (String)
• REQUIRES_SKILL (Level → MicroSkill & TargetRole → MicroSkill): id, organizationId, level [on Role edge], requiredKnowledgeLevels (String[]),
isMandatory (Boolean), version, status, reviewStatus, createdAt, updatedAt (DateTime | String)
• TEACHES (LearningModule → MicroSkill): id, organizationId, version, status, reviewStatus, reviewSource, reviewedBy, reviewedAt (String; 1 Skill per Module)
• HAS_SKILL_PREREQUISITE (MicroSkill → MicroSkill): id, organizationId, dependentKnowledgeLevel, prerequisiteKnowledgeLevel, version, status,
• REQUIRES_CERTIFICATE (MicroSkill → Certificate): organizationId, status, createdBy, createdAt; optional replacedBy, replacedByActor, replacedAt (String)
Constraints: per-label node id UNIQUE; JobPosition.code UNIQUE (V5); Department (organizationId, code) UNIQUE (V6); Competency.code UNIQUE; Certificate.id UNIQUE.
